text:
Type: cantilever bentwood lounge armchair
Use: relaxing, reading; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: layer-glued bent wood frame in a dark brown stain, padded woven fabric cushion
Colors: medium grey heathered fabric, dark brown wood
Shape: long one-piece cushion with a padded headrest, curved bentwood arms flowing into a springy cantilever base, reclined seat, open sides, medium visual weight
Feel: relaxed, cozy, calm, timeless
Goes with: dark wood, grey or white walls, wool rugs; Scandinavian or modern living rooms
